intro: Listen to an announcement in a psychology class.
text: Okay, before you go, a reminder about research participation. Everyone in this course needs to take part in three hours of psychology studies by the end of the semester. You can sign up for studies through the department website, and each one lists how long it takes. If you'd rather not participate, you can write a short summary of a published study instead. Just keep in mind that the sign-up system closes two weeks before finals.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the announcement?
options: To remind students of a course research requirement
To recruit volunteers for the professor's own study
To explain how to write a summary of a study
To announce that the department website has moved
questions.explanation: The professor reminds students that they must complete three hours of research participation and explains how to do it.

questions.prompt: What can students do if they do not want to take part in studies?
options: Take part in one longer study instead
Ask the professor for an exemption
Sign up for studies after finals
Write a summary of a published study
questions.explanation: She says students who would rather not participate can write a short summary of a published study instead.

intro: Listen to an announcement in an economics class.
text: Hi, everyone. Starting with problem set four, we're no longer collecting paper copies in class. Instead, please upload your work as a single PDF through the course website by Friday at midnight. If you work by hand, that's fine; just scan your pages with your phone and combine them into one file. Files that are hard to read won't be graded, so please check your scan carefully before you submit it.

options: Problem sets will now be due in class on Fridays.
Problem sets must now be typed, not handwritten.
Problem sets will now be graded by classmates.
Problem sets will now be submitted online.
questions.explanation: He explains that students will upload their problem sets as PDFs through the course website instead of handing in paper copies.

options: Unclear scans will not be graded.
Late files will lose points each day.
Phone photos are not accepted at all.
Only typed work can get full credit.
questions.explanation: He says files that are hard to read won't be graded, so students should check their scans.

intro: Listen to an announcement in a music appreciation class.
text: For this unit, each of you needs to attend one live concert and write a two-page response. The music department has several free student recitals over the next month, and any of those will count. Attend a student recital on campus as well
Write a response that is twice as long
Attach a ticket or program to their paper
questions.explanation: He says students who go to an off-campus concert must keep their ticket or program and attach it to the paper.

text: Next week we're doing peer review for your essay drafts. Bring two printed copies of your draft to class on Wednesday. options: Photograph the animals they see

Wear shoes without good grip
Take anything out of the pools
